definitions.explanation: A small, narrow body of flowing water, smaller than a river. Often found in natural settings like mountains, forests, or rural areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{小川|おがわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: A stream flows through the forest.

examples.japanese: {小川|おがわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|と}った→捕る：28715_toru⟧。
examples.english: I caught fish in the stream.

examples.japanese: {小川|おがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦せせらぎ→せせらぎ：10358_seseragi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear the murmuring of the brook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{小川|おがわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{水遊|みずあそ}び→水遊び：30257_mizuasobi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing in the stream.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{小川|おがわ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{増水|ぞうすい}→増水：16507_zousui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{近|ちか}づかないで→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When it rains heavily, this stream swells and becomes dangerous, so please stay away.

notes:
FORMS:
{小|お} (small) + ⟦{川|がわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧ (river) — a watercourse narrow enough to step across.

USAGE:
Belongs to scenic and nostalgic description more than to practical talk about water: ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小川|おがわ}, {小川|おがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧ (the flow of a stream), {小川|おがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦せせらぎ→せせらぎ：10358_seseragi⟧ (the babbling of a brook), often with ⟦さらさら→さらさら：05255_sarasara⟧ for the sound of the water. {小川|おがわ} is also a common surname (Ogawa), so a bare occurrence in a text may be a person, not a stream.

BY SIZE:
- ⟦{細流|さいりゅう}→細流：30258_sairyuu⟧ — a rivulet (literary)
- {小川|おがわ} — a stream, a brook
- ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧ — the general word, any size
- ⟦{大河|たいが}→大河：12197_taiga⟧ — a great river
